reviews.x: Bought this to use as a picture prop for my chihuahua, Davie Jones... here is a picture I took just to see how it would all fit together. (Sorry for the background mess, I was cleaning my craft room) I post my dogs pictures on their Facebook and Instagram and videos on their YouTube, so I’m always looking for cute things to use as props. I’ve not done a photo of Davie with his laptop besides this one testing it out. Growing up husky on Facebook, instagram and Youtube

reviews.t: My granddaughter loves it. It's part of her accessories ...
reviews.x: My granddaughter loves it.  It's part of her accessories for her American Girl dolls.  :-)

This little mirror is pretty adorable. It has a lot of little details. I bought it for my makeup bag but I think it would also make a great AG accessory. Everyone who has seen it thinks it's really cute. It was cheaper than some of the other mirrors like it on Amazon which made me a little worried it wouldn't be good quality but I am happily surprised with how well made it is.

Bought this just for fun. Thought it was kinda cool. Arrived quickly and has an apple like box and design. My main complaint is that I assumed it would have a stiffer hinge. This one just flops open. Setting it down and open like a laptop Is not possible. The one I got is white. Was hoping for silver but there is not color option that I noticed prior to ordering. Still pretty cool though.  Note: plastic film is still on it in my pic.

reviews.t: ITS SO CUTE. BUT SOME FLAWS
reviews.x: It's so cute. the only thing is that it is white and on some of the keys the have Chinese letters instead of English ones.
Great quality!!! So cute. I bought 5 to save back for birthday gifts for daughters friends. Even gave one to my 19yo niece. She loved it. Great price I think too. Comes in boc
This is a good size for a small dog to see if there is something in her fur.
I don't think this is an original product. It looks cheap and fake. The mirror itself is scratched.
Product exactly as promised.  Cute item.  My daughter loves it!

reviews.t: Very disappointed. Bought 2 of these and both of them ...
reviews.x: Very disappointed. Bought 2 of these and both of them have the "MacBook air" sign written upside down. I thought it was a fluke the first time, so tried again giving them the benefit of the doubt. My mistake. Would not recommend unless it doesn't bother you to be looking an upside down sign. To me, it is distracting and annoying.

Terrible. I remembered I ordered a mirror that's shaped like a MacBook air. I got the tiny toy MacBook air but where is the mirror?! It literally just has a white glob where the mirror is suppose to be. If you want a bad quality toy for $10, be my guest. However, if you want a mirror, like I did, go elsewhere.b

Super CUTE Compact Mirror. MY Daughter asked for a Laptop for Christmas. I made her think it was out of the question and gave her this to open first. Told her MERRY CHRISTMAS... and she laughed but loved it, The big surprise was when she opened the real life version of this mini MAC Compact.  Loved it.

reviews.t: Lol) I’m sure they work just fine!
reviews.x: Cute, but my daughters actually wanted these for their American girl dolls. They don’t stay opened. If you want it for a mirror (which I didn’t even know it was until I received them. Lol) I’m sure they work just fine!

reviews.t: Im a man that wanted a mirror without looking like a chick with a compact
reviews.x: Im a man that wanted a mirror without looking like a chick with a compact.  Amazing what a little logo can do.
Very cute idea and my daughter is using this as a computer for her 18 inch doll as well as a mirror!

reviews.t: Scratched up...small black marks on it too
reviews.x: I received the product scratched up. It also had a few small black marks on it which I was able to get off. The product looked used...but the package looks new. I was planning to give it to a friend, but it looks used so I can't anymore because even after cleaning this product, the scratches were too noticable to give to anyone

reviews.t: If you pay attention to detail you'll hate this.
reviews.x: The apple on this is the wrong way, and the paint was already peeling off when I got it. Look somewhere else for the silver one. The apple is oriented the correct way (so that when its open the apple logo isn't upside down) and it actually looks like a little macbook. I use this as a toy for my pet parrot. He loves it.

reviews.t: Looked cute online, but not worth the price
reviews.x: The cover is very loose and wiggles around and won't hold itself open. The keys are so small the letters are very hard to read. Not really enough to it to be a fun doll toy. Could be a compact mirror, but the loose lid is a problem. I might return it....
It's a very cute mirror but it had tiny flaws. It doesn't close all the way and there was a tiny chip but other than that its everything i expected it to be so over all very pleased.
Bought this for my girlfriend and she finds it cute. She would take it out and we'd have a few good laughs at it.  It does its job, that's for sure -- as both a toy and a mirror.

Cute prop for a 1/3 size BJD. Much more detailed than I expected! Only semi-negative is that it is white instead of silver, which I believed it was from the pictures. For my usage, that is fine, but would have been nice if I could tell that going in. The white seems to pick up dark scratches pretty easily. Unlike other reviewers, I have not had any issues with the hinge. Holds position closed/fully open/partially open just fine with gentle usage.

The quality is insanely cheap. The cost to make these things are less than a dollar and they're charging $10!!! This is my second time ordering from a different seller hoping to get a better quality as my previous one came with a broken mirror, but NOPE they're all a gamble. The mirror is so flimsy if you drop it once it's going to get destroyed. The apple logo isn't even centered!!

reviews.t: Resolution is fantastic but came with a dead pixel
reviews.x: Pros: -Fantastic true to life resolution -great performance -9000hz refresh rate -portable  cons: -screen gets dirty easily -buttons are extremely stiff -storage space incredibly small -Fragile as all apple products are -Came with 1 dead pixel -Apple overcharges for repairs especially for 1 dead pixel.

I used this mainly as a photo prop ( @ _tata_fam_ on ig) and it works really well! I haven’t used it as an actual mirror yet but it’s perfectly pocket sized and the mirror came with a film protector on it and was free of scratches. The keys even have little letters printed on them!

It comes in a box that looks just like the apple computers it is a nice little mirror and it works great for American girl dolls. It is so real looking and the box is so nice. It was a really good item and I think you will think so too  and it will look great in your collection.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the mirror as cute and adorable.
Several customers use it as an accessory or prop for dolls and pets.
Some reviewers report quality problems such as scratches, upside-down branding, or a missing mirror.
A few customers note the hinge is loose and the mirror does not stay open.
Some reviewers mention the keys have Chinese letters instead of English.
